_readme: Sprite skin manifest (see Source/Manager/SpriteLibrary.hx). A spawn's 'sprite' field names a skin here; each skin maps to enemy art and the bullet art its patterns fire. A part can be a plain asset path string, or an object {source, rect: [x,y,w,h] spritesheet cell, scale}. Optional animation on that object: frames (integer >= 2), fps (default 8), frameW, frameH, mode ('loop'|'once'|'pingpong', default loop). Frames are one horizontal strip with no gaps: frame i is the cell (originX + i*frameW, originY, frameW, frameH). origin is rect's x,y when rect is set, else 0,0. frameW/frameH default to rect's width/height — rect is the FIRST cell, not the box around the whole strip — or, with no rect, floor(imageWidth/frames) by the full image height. Cells that would extend past the image are dropped. Omit frames and the part stays the single static bitmap. Skins 'default' and 'enemy2' are built into the engine; entries here override or extend them. A sprite value ending in .png bypasses the manifest entirely (direct drop-in with default bullets).
